summary: Gorax presents the top-tier Aura affinity team setup for facing the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque. The setup relies on Talethia as the primary HP-scaling DPS supported by Diantha, Lincos, Anneliesis, and Rena. The team achieves massive damage scores ranging from 400M+ at zero inspiration to over 2.6B+ with min-maxed gear. The guide details exact gear priorities, artifact choices, debuff-reflection mechanics, and automated 15-second skill timings.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Primary HP-scaling Aura damage dealer built with HP%, Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and Golden Alarm artifact.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Built with high Resistance and Prismatic Cloak to reflect boss debuffs while sharing Attack with the team.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Applies Defense Penalty and Bleed debuffs using Witch's Remains and Conflagration of Bones to amplify team damage.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Provides team shielding and attack buffs built with high Accuracy and HP.

heroes.name: Rena
heroes.note: Provides critical buffs and enables a tight 15-second skill rotation built with Defense and Haste.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Can replace Rena if unowned, though the team rotation extends from 15s to 18s.

teams.note: Best performing Aura composition vs Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque using Golden Tressem familiar.

tips: Prioritize HP%, Crit Rate, and Crit Damage over Attack on Aura heroes like Talethia since their damage scales with HP.
Equip Lincos with high Resistance and Prismatic Cloak to reflect freezing debuffs back onto the boss to boost Talethia's damage multiplier.
Equip Diantha with Witch's Remains and Conflagration of Bones to apply additional debuffs (Def Penalty, Bleed) on Mekkatorque.
Set hero skill recast timings to 15.0 seconds (18.0s if using Solmo instead of Rena) and pet recast timing to 30.0 seconds.
title: Best Aura Team vs Mekkatorque | Rasp of Gears S8 | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
